description: The tool call tracker adds zero tokens to agent prompts, zero latency to tool execution, and zero API calls; it is completely passive and operates only on the return path after tool execution

preconditions.description: The tool call tracker is active and logging tool calls

expectedOutcome.description: No additional tokens are injected into agent context, no additional API calls are made, and tool execution latency is unaffected (logging is fire-and-forget)
